name: Himachal Pradesh
description: Discover the breathtaking seasonal beauty, rich cultural heritage, and legendary gastronomy of Himachal Pradesh.

cuisine.name: Dham

cuisine.name: Siddu
cuisine.desc: Steamed wheat bread stuffed with roasted poppy seeds & walnuts, served with ghee.

cuisine.name: Chha Gosht
cuisine.desc: Marinated lamb cooked slowly in buttermilk & aromatic spices.

festivals.name: Himachal Pradesh Festival
festivals.desc: A vibrant regional celebration of culture and heritage.
